messages:
nina: Quick proposal — our current 429 UX is too vague. It just shows "quota exceeded" and a request id. Customers keep DMing support asking what to change immediately.

aj: Agree. What are we proposing? actionable links + telemetry?

nina: Yes. Minimal change: 1) show `request_id` prominently, 2) show `retry_after` and approximate current vs configured rate, 3) add an inline link to the per-key usage view, 4) provide two recommended next steps (reduce rps, enable batching), and 5) a single-click "Open support ticket" that includes request_id + sampling trace. Example SDK error payload we surface (so console + SDK can render the same):

```json
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after_ms":1200,"request_id":"req_abc123","current_rps":350,"limit_rps":300,"burst_tokens":0}
```

samuel: Nice. A couple of implementation Qs: do we show per-org totals or per-key only? how do bursts interact — we should expose `burst_tokens` and `x-burst-remaining` header in API so SDKs can surface proactive throttling.

leo: From Console side: show per-key link like `/console/usage/keys/req_abc123` and open the usage pane filtered to last 5 minutes. Also add a tiny chart sparkline next to the error in the toast. That helps reduce a 1:1 to support.

aj: For messaging copy, suggest short actionable language: "Rate limit reached. Try again in 1.2s — reduce per-second calls, enable batching, or upgrade plan. View key usage (link) · Open ticket". Keep it 1 line for toasts, expanded details for the modal.

nina: Telemetry requirements: include request_id, trace_id (if present), customer org id, key id, and the aggregated rps snapshot (5s window). We should sample full trace for 1/1000 429s and store in error-trace index. That lets SREs and support debug bad client loops.

devex-bot: Created docs ticket DOCS-482: "429 UX + actionable telemetry links" and added initial spec to the docs backlog.

ops-bot: Rolling plan: will canary `429-ux-v2` to 10% of traffic on staging cluster tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Will post results.

nina: Plan: @aj to prototype console toast + modal, @samuel to update SDK error schema and header guidance, @leo to wire the usage-link; i'll follow up with PR for telemetry sampling. Can we ship a minimal iteration that only adds the link + retry_after in toast this sprint? :thumbsup:

aj: Yup, i'll scope a quick prototype and link a screenshot here when ready.

samuel: I'll PR SDK spec with `burst_tokens` + `retry_after_ms` by EOD Friday.

nina: Great — thanks everyone. Keeping it short so we can iterate.
